feed_title: GTA 6 Verified Launch Glitches, Money Loops & Walkthrough Videos

items.title: 1. Apollo Aggregates (Red Barn) Infinite Money Loop
items.summary: Fastest repeatable launch-week cash glitch in GTA 6 Story Mode — exploits warehouse & parked truck container restocking via manual Save & Reload.
steps: Drive a personal vehicle with 4+ trunk duffel slots to Apollo Aggregates (Red Barn) in South Vice-Dale County.
Clear the open red-barn warehouse pallets and the parked supply truck next to the loading bay, loading 4/4 loot bags straight into your vehicle trunk.
Open your Pause Menu and trigger a manual Save (Slot #15) → Reload Save — your trunk retains all 4 bags while the warehouse & truck loot instantly restocks.
Drive south to Brian's Lockup (Keypad Code: 7700) and fence the full load for ~$55,000 per run. Repeat until topped up, then bank cash at physical ATMs (remember the $20K loose pocket cap!).

sourceEvidence.label: Launch-Week Playtest Verification (Slot #15 Save/Reload)
sourceEvidence.summary: Verified repeatable 4-bag trunk restock loop at Apollo Aggregates (South Vice-Dale County) fenced via Brian's Lockup (7700). Note: Keep separate from Lab Fees story objective.

statusHistory.note: Initial community report of warehouse & parked truck container restocking on reload.
Confirmed reproducible on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S using Manual Save Slot #15.

items.title: 2. First-Person Camera Glitch (Missing Native FPS View Workaround)
items.summary: GTA 6 launched without a dedicated on-foot First-Person toggle. This cover-aim camera lock lets you explore Vice City interiors and streets in pseudo-first-person.
steps: Switch camera distance to the closest third-person preset (Touchpad / View button) and stand flush against a low exterior corner wall.
Enter cover (R1 / RB), pull up your smartphone camera (D-Pad Up), then simultaneously tap Aim (L2 / LT) + Exit Cover as the phone lens transitions.
Your camera anchors tight over Jason or Lucia's eye line until you enter a cutscene, climb a ladder, or enter a vehicle.

sourceEvidence.label: Console Cover-Camera Transition Verification
sourceEvidence.summary: Confirmed eye-line camera lock via corner cover + smartphone camera + simultaneous aim/exit cover on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

statusHistory.note: Discovered by players testing photo/phone transitions after launch confirmed no native on-foot FPS toggle.
Verified working on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S until entering vehicles, ladders, or cutscenes.

items.title: 3. Xbox Series X 120Hz FPS Unlock Glitch (Build 01.002.001)
items.summary: Bypasses the default 30 FPS frame-cap container on Xbox Series X launch build 01.002.001 when paired with a 120Hz VRR TV/monitor, unlocking variable 40–50+ FPS in open-world cruising.
steps: In Xbox System Settings → TV & Display Options, set Refresh Rate to 120Hz and enable Allow Variable Refresh Rate (VRR).
Launch GTA 6 (build 01.002.001) into free-roam on Save Slot #15, open the Pause Menu → Display, and toggle Motion Blur OFF.
Tap the Xbox Guide button to suspend briefly into the Dashboard Settings, toggle Allow 4K / VRR refresh handshake, then immediately Quick Resume back into GTA 6.
Note: Frame pacing fluctuates in dense Vice City traffic — works best on a 120Hz HDMI 2.1 VRR monitor.
items.platform: Xbox Series X Only (Requires 120Hz HDMI 2.1 + VRR)

sourceEvidence.label: Xbox Series X VRR Refresh Handshake Testing
sourceEvidence.summary: Community hardware testers observed unlocked 40–50+ FPS frame pacing after Quick Resume VRR handshake on Xbox Series X. Results vary by display and scene load; tagged Testing.

statusHistory.note: Early reports of bypassed 30 FPS container on Xbox Series X with 120Hz VRR enabled.
Reproduced on select HDMI 2.1 120Hz VRR panels; frame pacing remains inconsistent in dense Vice City traffic.

items.title: 4. Store Cooldown Timer Reset Glitch
items.summary: Skips the in-game 48-minute store police-tape lockdown so you can chain high-value Port Gellhorn pawn shops and Vice City boutiques back-to-back.
steps: Rob your target convenience store, pawn shop, or jewelry boutique and escape your 1–3 star wanted level.
Deliver and sell all duffel loot to your nearest fence (Randy, Brian's Lockup 7700, or Yasmani) and bank pocket cash at an ATM.
Move at least two blocks away from the shop, create a manual save on Slot #15, and immediately reload that save — the store shutter re-opens with full registers and display cases.

sourceEvidence.label: Free-Roam Robbery Cooldown Reload Verification
sourceEvidence.summary: Moving two blocks away and reloading a manual save resets police-tape lockdown timers on convenience, pawn, and jewelry stores.

statusHistory.note: Reported during Chapter 1–3 pawn shop and jewelry robbery chaining.
Verified working across Story Mode free-roam on Build 01.002.001.

items.title: 5. Prologue Boat Chase Skip (Roof Jump → Alley Boat Skip)
items.summary: Verified launch-day speedrun bypass that skips the scripted coastal boat pursuit sequence during the opening chapter.
steps: When fleeing down the marina boardwalk toward the pier, cut hard left up the wooden AC unit crate onto the low boathouse roof instead of sprinting to the main dock trigger.
Sprint across the rooftop ridge and leap directly into the narrow canal alley behind the boat slip, landing right beside the docked getaway skiff.
Board immediately to bypass the scripted patrol-boat ambush wave and trigger the escape checkpoint early.

sourceEvidence.label: Launch Speedrun Route Verification
sourceEvidence.summary: Confirmed rooftop AC crate climb and alley boat jump bypassing the scripted marina patrol boat pursuit wave (~3.5 minutes saved).

statusHistory.note: First surfaced in launch-day speedrun routing streams.
Confirmed repeatable on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 6. Crab Outpost Keypad Bypass / Cache Codes (CLEAVES / 0072 / 0212)
items.summary: Launch-week community reports claim keypad codes CLEAVES, 0072, and 0212 unlock secondary Crab Outpost lockboxes or allow early access. Currently unconfirmed pending independent in-game capture.
steps: Treat circulating Crab Outpost combinations (CLEAVES, 0072, 0212) as Unverified until confirmed with repeatable video capture.
Always test unverified world interactions on an isolated manual save (Slot #15) rather than your main story save.

sourceEvidence.label: Community Submissions — Pending Independent Verification
sourceEvidence.summary: Flagged Unverified in accordance with our strict accuracy guardrail; will only promote to Confirmed Working after 3+ independent verifications.

statusHistory.note: Logged as Unverified while awaiting independent in-game confirmation.
